headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty traded with volatility driven by geopolitical cues, crude oil, and foreign inflows.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: Geopolitical risks, crude oil price movements, and corporate earnings are steering market sentiment.
Buying in heavyweights like Reliance and foreign institutional inflows supported early gains in previous sessions.
Elevated crude oil prices above $116 and a rising India VIX elevated market volatility.
Investors are tracking Wall Street trends and historical S&P 500 signals ahead of the upcoming Diwali week.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed on Sunday for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, November 3.
Maruti Suzuki registered record monthly sales led by strong performance in its SUV segment.
Godrej Properties set a revenue recognition target of ₹40,000 crore by March 2028.
Indian Oil Corporation utilized 37% of its ₹32,700 crore FY27 capex target during the first half of the year.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.
During recent sessions, indices exhibited volatility influenced by crude oil prices, foreign inflows, and global market cues.
Traders are watching upcoming corporate earnings, geopolitical developments, and Diwali week trends for direction.
